content.text:
Wolfram|Alpha returns **9,675 days** between February 12, 2024 and August 9, 2050.

I entered the question in the site's search box and read the result from the page. The page also gives the time span as 26 years, 5 months, 28 days, or about 1,382 weeks and 1 day. I checked the count by hand: 26 years contain 7 leap days (Feb 29 in 2024, 2028, …, 2048), so 26 × 365 + 7 = 9,497, plus 178 days from Feb 12 to Aug 9, 2050, gives 9,675.
